risks.risk: Battery health/remaining capacity (may not hold charge well).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing it fully charged, then running at least 30–60 minutes with brightness level visible (or a runtime test).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a rechargeable torch with unknown battery condition (worst case: weak/short runtime).

risks.risk: Brightness/output (lumen rating) and whether it’s dim/defective.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video comparing brightness in a dark room (same distance) and any label showing lumen rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as low/unknown output (worst case: not bright).

risks.risk: Charging method and compatibility (USB vs adapter vs solar; wrong charger may be missing).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up of the charging port label + what charger is included (photo of charger/adapter and port).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as missing/unknown charger or requiring a compatible charger.

risks.proof: Ask for any IP rating or a brief drop/splash test video (if the seller can).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as indoor-use only / unknown durability.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any label on the torch showing brand/model, lumen rating, battery capacity, and charging input specs.
Video: charge indicator (if any) + runtime test in a dark room (30–60 minutes).
Photo of the included charger/adapter and a close-up of the charging port.
response.reason: The photos show a generic rechargeable LED torch/light but do not provide readable model/specs or evidence of battery/runtime and brightness. Without that, a reliable worst-case price in Abuja can’t be set confidently.
